tools.name: provision_app
tools.description: Set up long-term memory for an app with no account: makes a new app and its key, as `POST /v1/auth/provision` does. The answer carries the app key once, and the assistant is told to put it in the owner's secret store and nowhere else. Needs no key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "provision_app" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
